entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It's hard to believe this day has..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Sal and I stepped outside, the w..."
entries.dialogueText: As Sal and I stepped outside, the wind swept by us, carrying a thunderous chorus of cheers. There must have been hundreds of thousands in attendance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal's resonant voice from the micro..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal's resonant voice from the microphone pierced through the clamor of the crowd.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Rizia! Hear me!""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia! Hear me!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It didn't take long for the crowd t..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Today is perhaps the greatest day..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today is perhaps the greatest day in our kingdom's history!"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Brothers and sisters... I present..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brothers and sisters... I present to you the promised king, the prophesied king, our king... Romus the First!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Cheers and whistles were heard. Onc..."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""People of Rizia! We now revel in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "People of Rizia! We now revel in the light of the one true God!"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""None of this would be possible wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "None of this would be possible without he who walks and spreads the word of the Divine!"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""His will is second only to that of..."
entries.dialogueText: "His will is second only to that of God!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd began chanting my name."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd began chanting my name.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then that the five members o..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then that the five members of the Council of Nur -- archpriests who replaced my old council -- emerged, each cloaked in a ceremonial robe.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your guidance. God b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your guidance. God bless you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we will accomplish what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we will accomplish what the previous council could not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Grand Wiseman Ignacius, I'm truly..."
entries.dialogueText: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius, I'm truly thankful for gathering everyone here today. I hold each of you in the highest regard."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They began chanting a continuous pr..."
entries.dialogueText: They began chanting a continuous prayer, seemingly lost in their devotion.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Halaita, brothers.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita, brothers."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""By God's will, we shall proceed.""

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.dialogueText: "God's word is our weapon against the tyranny of mankind!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We owe our success to you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We are a nation that knows peril!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We are a nation that knows betrayal!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "But that's what gives us our strength!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "And we will know many more!"

entries.dialogueText: "I stand before you as your king, ready to lead us out of this darkness."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I demand change and so shall you!""

entries.dialogueText: "For it is you who have shown me that true change comes from within!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "We can not fail to forget the past! Or we will be doomed to make the same mistakes again!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hear your calls and I'm in agree..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear your calls and I'm in agreement!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let go of the past and concentrate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let go of the past and concentrate on what awaits us ahead! For dwelling on it only hinders our progress!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What matters is that you are here..."
entries.dialogueText: "What matters is that you are here with me! Right here! Right now!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Labor tirelessly without complaint..."
entries.dialogueText: "Labor tirelessly without complaint and eternal peace will be your reward!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Amidst all this, do not lose sight..."
entries.dialogueText: "Amidst all this, do not lose sight of what truly matters... our heavenly Father above!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've seen it first hand! I know th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've seen it first hand! I know the people of Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Think of your children! Without ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think of your children! Without our sacrifices, their future is bleak!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But do not run yourself rampant in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But do not run yourself rampant in the pursuit of enlightenment! For, according to God's will, true clarity comes at the appointed hour."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that we will succeed! All w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that we will succeed! All we need is perseverance!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia demands -- no. *I* demand yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia demands -- no. *I* demand your eternal fealty!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Times may be hard! But so am I! An..."
entries.dialogueText: "Times may be hard! But so am I! And so are you!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you do not stand with me, I can..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you do not stand with me, I cannot predict what fate may befall our beloved country!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our children will finish what we s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our children will finish what we start today!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We must safeguard what lies ahead..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must safeguard what lies ahead with all we have!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But do not be deceived! One misste..."
entries.dialogueText: "But do not be deceived! One misstep and we risk everything!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "If you stumble, fear not! I will pull you out of this darkness!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With unwavering devotion, victory..."
entries.dialogueText: "With unwavering devotion, victory will be ours!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll be there to witness the futur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be there to witness the future unfold, even at the risk of my life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Have faith! Because at the end of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have faith! Because at the end of the day, all we have is each other!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sound the bells! For Rizia is comi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sound the bells! For Rizia is coming! Our destiny beckons!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're the beginning of a new dawn!""
entries.dialogueText: "You're the beginning of a new dawn!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head and spoke in a s..."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head and spoke in a soft whisper.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I couldn't go through with it in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I couldn't go through with it in the end, Romus. I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head and spoke in a s..."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head and spoke in a soft whisper.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It was this or prison.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was this or prison."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sal, don't do this. It will destro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sal, don't do this. It will destroy her."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shook her head and spoke in a s..."
entries.dialogueText: She shook her head and spoke in a soft whisper.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""It's all right, Romus. It's for th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's all right, Romus. It's for the good of the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mother. How could you be so stupid?""
entries.dialogueText: "Mother. How could you be so stupid?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's 75 years old. Her beliefs ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's 75 years old. Her beliefs aren't hurting anyone."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I could ask you the same thing. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I could ask you the same thing. Your father may have practiced Wruhecism, but he never would have turned Rizia into the Grand Wiseman's personal pulpit."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The law is the law, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "The law is the law, Your Majesty. She must relinquish Dastnurity if she wants to remain in Rizia. And she has agreed to do so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is not too late, Mother. It is..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not too late, Mother. It is never too late."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Her Highness has already agreed to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her Highness has already agreed to relinquish Dastnurity, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I believe you're making a mistake,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe you're making a mistake, son. Rizia needs a king, not a cult leader."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""But the Royal Family must stand to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the Royal Family must stand together. No matter what."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at Titus and Sal."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at Titus and Sal.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I'm ready.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm ready."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal took her hand and together, the..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal took her hand and together, they stepped up to the microphone. An acolyte stood by with a bowl of glowing coals and a tray containing 11 slips of parchment -- one for each tenet of Dastnurity.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You did this without my permission..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did this without my permission? Are you trying to bring shame on my family?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""He was only executing your orders,..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was only executing your orders, Romus."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yes, dear people of Rizia, our ver..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, dear people of Rizia, our very own Queen Mother has come forward as a secret practitioner of the forbidden old ways!"

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""But St. Wruhec preached forgivenes..."
entries.dialogueText: "But St. Wruhec preached forgiveness, and our great and merciful King shall grant it!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd roared louder than ever...."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd roared louder than ever. The acolyte held the tray out to my mother, and she took one of the slips off of it.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""With this Rite of Severance, the Q..."
entries.dialogueText: "With this Rite of Severance, the Queen Mother is reborn into the fold. Showing that there is no one too old, too wicked, too far gone to be saved."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a trembling hand, she placed t..."
entries.dialogueText: With a trembling hand, she placed the parchment into the bowl. In an instant, it transformed into ash.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Yes! Her Highness is destroying th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes! Her Highness is destroying the forces that once held sway over her, replacing them with the eternal light of the six stars!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One by one, she cast the other slip..."
entries.dialogueText: One by one, she cast the other slips into the fire, wincing each time as if it were her own skin that was burning.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""The holy fire has cleansed her, as..."
entries.dialogueText: "The holy fire has cleansed her, as it will every one of you! Walk this path with us! Let your kingdom be your salvation!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The palace grounds resounded with s..."
entries.dialogueText: The palace grounds resounded with screams of approval and shouts of "Halaita!".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother stepped back towards the..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother stepped back towards the doors. There were no tears in her eyes -- in fact, there was no emotion at all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I realized that Sal and the entire..."
entries.dialogueText: I realized that Sal and the entire crowd were waiting for my words.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God bless Queen Mother Estela! And..."
entries.dialogueText: "God bless Queen Mother Estela! And God bless Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As the Grand Wiseman has spoken, s..."
entries.dialogueText: "As the Grand Wiseman has spoken, so it shall be! Divine salvation awaits those who follow the words of Wruhec!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The path of redemption is not an e..."
entries.dialogueText: "The path of redemption is not an easy one. Let us praise the Queen Mother for her bravery!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks for the warm-up, Sal. I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the warm-up, Sal. I'll take it from here."
